name: com.google.android.datatransport.runtime.backends.TransportBackendDiscovery
description: Google Android Data Transport keeps this Service in the manifest to register Google's event-upload backend. When an SDK queues telemetry or diagnostic events, the transport runtime reads this registration to route them for upload.
disableEffect: Disabling it can stop telemetry or diagnostic events that use this backend from uploading, while ordinary app screens remain available.
